Heather / Marcus — see inline summary of legal's position after first pass. I've also attached a tracked copy (DataFlux_MSA_redline_v3_priyom_comments.docx).

Top-line legal feedback (high priority):
1) Audit logs & retention: we can commit to maintaining API access logs for 12 months; we will provide SOC2 Type II evidence on request but cannot grant direct access to internal logs. Proposed clause: Redwood will retain and produce system audit logs for a period of twelve (12) months upon reasonable request and subject to Redwood's standard audit procedures.

2) Data residency: DataFlux's original ask to pin EU-only residency for all data is material. We can offer regional routing controls for customer data and a best-effort approach for EU-only compute in dedicated deployments, but not for hosted accounts without a private deployment addendum.

3) Indemnity / liability cap: we are comfortable with a $5M aggregate cap for this renewal; if DataFlux requires a higher cap for a longer term, commercial should advise.

4) Order form: need explicit overage calculation and a one-time ramp credit to cover Q3 onboarding spikes. Please see rows 14-18 in the workbook.

Next steps: Marcus — if you confirm commercial flex on term/credit, we'll produce a clean redline. Irene, can you please review the SOC2 language and confirm the exact phrasing?

Priyom
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
